answer: A farm of 88 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in zephyr, queued in pulse, and quartz publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 11 identities per epoch. A farm of 3441 identities would post 4639 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
